headline: [Peace Push!] Trump Asks Putin to Pull Back [Military Aggression] in Europe
sub: Trump calls Ukraine war a "complete bloodbath"
caption:
🕊️ Peace Push! Trump Asks Putin to Pull Back Military Aggression in Europe

US President Donald Trump said on Thursday that he asked Russian President Vladimir Putin to "pull back all military aggression against territories throughout Europe". He wrote on Truth Social that he raised this during their talks in China last week, "in the hopes that a deal can be made between Russia and Ukraine, and made quickly."

🔹 Trump said a deal is "a strong possibility" and called the war "a complete bloodbath", saying thousands of people are killed every month.
🔹 Speaking to reporters at Mar-a-Lago in Florida, Trump said: "The biggest problem to that settlement is the fact that you have two leaders that really hate each other."
🔹 Trump said he would like Putin to attend the G20 summit in Florida on December 14-15. The Kremlin said no decision has been made on that.

💬 Do you think a Russia-Ukraine peace deal is close? 👇

Sources: Reuters, AFP, RFE/RL

headline: [Hung Parliament!] New Zealand Election Final Count Leaves Luxon [One Seat Short]
sub: Small Opportunity party holds the balance
caption:
🗳️ Hung Parliament! New Zealand Election Final Count Leaves Luxon One Seat Short

The final count of New Zealand's 7 November election, released on Friday, left no group with a majority. Prime Minister Christopher Luxon's right-wing bloc won 65 of the 130 seats, one seat short of the number needed to govern alone.

🔹 Luxon's National Party lost two seats when special votes were counted. The left-wing bloc led by Labour's Chris Hipkins has 58 seats.
🔹 The centrist Opportunity party, led by Qiulae Wong, won 7 seats and now holds the balance of power.
🔹 Wong has said she will first negotiate with the party that has the most seats. Luxon's bloc needs Opportunity's support to form a government.

💬 Should small parties get to decide who runs a country? 👇

Sources: AP, Reuters

#GlobalEye #NewZealand #NZElection #Luxon #Politics
photo_needed: New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon, face clearly visible (or New Zealand's Parliament building, the 'Beehive', in Wellington). A big, clear, landscape photo works best.

headline: [Pact Sealed!] Turkey Ratifies Defence Pact With [Pakistan and Saudi Arabia]
sub: Three-nation defence talks begin in Islamabad
caption:
🤝 Pact Sealed! Turkey Ratifies Defence Pact With Pakistan and Saudi Arabia

Turkey has completed its approval of the Mecca joint defence agreement with Pakistan and Saudi Arabia. President Recep Tayyip Erdogan signed off on the pact, and it was published in Turkey's Official Gazette on Friday. Turkey's parliament approved it earlier this month.

🔹 The pact treats an attack on any one of the three countries as an attack on all of them.
🔹 It was signed in Mecca in August by Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, President Erdogan and Pakistan's Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif. Members can only leave after 10 years.
🔹 Senior defence and foreign affairs officials from the three countries are meeting in Islamabad from Friday. AP reports that Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia are on the agenda.

💬 Will this pact make the region safer? 👇

Sources: AP, Reuters

#GlobalEye #Pakistan #Turkey #SaudiArabia #DefencePact #Erdogan
photo_needed: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan with Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman and Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif (e.g. the Mecca signing in August), or Erdogan alone, faces clearly visible. A big, clear, landscape photo works best.

headline: [Deadly Strike!] Houthis Say Saudi Airstrike in Yemen Kills [At Least 11]
sub: Children among dead in Taiz province, Houthis say
caption:
💥 Deadly Strike! Houthis Say Saudi Airstrike in Yemen Kills At Least 11

An airstrike hit a building in the city of al-Turbah, in Yemen's Taiz province, early on Friday. The Houthi-run health ministry said at least 11 people were killed, including children, and blamed Saudi Arabia. The toll could not be independently verified.

🔹 AP reports the strike hit a former cinema building where people, including children who sold ice cream, were living. Houthi media said rescuers were still searching the rubble for missing people.
🔹 The Saudi-led coalition has not commented on the strike. Later on Friday, it said it had destroyed a Houthi drone launched towards the Riyadh region.
🔹 Fighting between the Houthis and Yemen's government, backed by the Saudi-led coalition, restarted in July after a 2022 truce collapsed.

💬 What can be done to protect civilians in Yemen? 👇

Sources: AP, Al Jazeera, dpa

#GlobalEye #Yemen #Taiz #SaudiArabia #Houthis #MiddleEast
photo_needed: The damaged building or rescue scene in al-Turbah, Taiz province, Yemen (from a news agency photo), or a general photo of Taiz city, Yemen. A big, clear, landscape photo works best.
